verifiedBoundaries: Transport uses the fixed home-mac host and fixed backup source and receipt destination; dynamic remote path components are validated package IDs and hexadecimal hashes.
M5 creates the signed observation from bytes actually read into its local ciphertext cache, and detects ciphertext or manifest replacement before publishing a receipt.
Cached observations and existing signed M1 observations retain the exact original receipt bytes and timestamps on retry; old observations are not renewed.
The signing private key stays in M5 private state; the separate archive worker receives only the public key.
Two complete owned cache entries are retained, including the current package; unknown, incomplete, modified or linked entries are preserved.
Timeout tests verify termination of an ignoring process and its ignoring grandchild.
Receipt delivery to M1 precedes optional M5 iCloud archival, and archive failure returns a visible ARCHIVE_FAILED state without revoking the completed independent read.

M1 snapshot cycle performs all iCloud mkdir, rsync, cp and mv actions after successful legal registration, under a 60-second bound, recording archiveStatus=failed and ICLOUD_ARCHIVE_FAILED on failure.
Archive retention deletes only validated, locally signed receipts strictly older than seven days, preserving current/cache-pinned observations and unknown, unsigned or linked files.

closedFindings.closure: All archive operations now follow successful register and run under a bounded if branch with visible nonfatal failure state; shell syntax and control flow independently rechecked.

closedFindings.finding: Archive publication used existsSync and overwrote an unknown dangling symlink.
closedFindings.minimalReproductionBeforeFix: A synthetic dangling final receipt symlink was replaced by archiveReceipt; its target was absent.
closedFindings.closure: lstat detects existing links; linkSync performs atomic publication without replacement; EEXIST validates unchanged matching bytes. Regression tests independently passed for dangling links, a concurrently created different file, and preservation/rejection of an interrupted nlink=2 publication.

fieldVerificationStillRequired: Root deployment owner verifies actual home-mac SSH access and source/destination state, stages the reviewed file hashes, and captures an actual M5 signed read delivered to M1.
Root deployment owner verifies retired old backup producers and manual register/deploy/restore writers are absent before cutting only the backup job.
The old sealed deployment tools have not gained the new fence mutex merely through this backup-only cut; later deploy/restore must stop backup and use the compatible locked tools.
